inTheSaucer.say: Grey: Oh crap. Oh crap, man, the human. It's awake!
Other grey: Why is it doing the thing with the eyes? I hate when they do that thing with the eyes man.
Grey: Just.. just put him under until we get back! No. No again. NO. NO!! The other OTHER button! The one that isn't the antenna dimwit. NO!
Saucer radio: *scractches in*...smooth jazz, allllllll niiiiiiiiiight looooooong...*gurbles out*
Narrator: So then some time later... exactly how much later is classified above even the President's pay grade:

inThePines.say: Grey: Hey. Hey, man. You gotta wake up. You gotta wake up.

Other grey: Sorry about the abduction and all man. Genuinely.
There was a mix-up with the paperwork it was never supposed to be you I guess. Funny huh? Yea well... I guess humans do a good news bad news things soooo that was the good news you're back and not probed (much)!
But yea... um... we hate to do this to ya...
Grey: But you've got bigger problems now. MUCH bigger problems.
Other grey: Let's Hit The ROAD man!

Grey: Do what this thing says man...
or your whole race is likely toast. That's not a threat. We like toast. We really do!
But yea there are bad, bad, BAD forces at play here man.
Coming this way right now. That's three bads. We don't use three bads lightly in our culture.
Voice from the saucer: Guys! Out! NOW! We are double-parked over a national forest Area 51 guys hate when we do that and... IT. Let's jam!
You: ...Gary is going to be so mad he slept through this.
